const [host, ...args] = process.argv.slice(2);
const range = (args[args.indexOf('-p') + 1] || '1-1024').split('-').map(Number);
const timeout = Number(args[args.indexOf('--timeout') + 1]) || 300;

async function probe(port) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const sock = net.connect({ host, port });
    const t = setTimeout(() => { sock.destroy(); resolve(false); }, timeout);
    sock.on('connect', () => { clearTimeout(t); sock.end(); resolve(true); });
    sock.on('error', () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(false); });
  });
}

for (let p = range[0]; p <= range[1]; p++) {
  if (await probe(p)) console.log(`${p}/tcp open`);
}
